name: little-log
description: A child tracker that grows from newborn to 18 – web app, packaged for iOS and Android with Capacitor

scripts.sync: npm run build:web && cap sync && node scripts/native-config.js
scripts.android: npm run sync && cap open android
scripts.ios: npm run sync && cap open ios
scripts.apk: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.aab: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
scripts.test: npm run lint && node tests/db.test.js && node tests/e2e.test.js && node tests/children.test.js && node tests/features.test.js && node tests/robust.test.js && node tests/routine.test.js && node tests/report.test.js && node tests/solids.test.js && node tests/families.test.js && node tests/growing.test.js && node tests/health.test.js && node tests/school.test.js && node tests/teen.test.js && node tests/media.test.js && node tests/pictures.test.js && node tests/start.test.js && node tests/languages.test.js
